subject: Occu function - R Session aborting on singular line every time.

messages.author: 74fec7d7f108ed9b
messages.subject: Occu function - R Session aborting on singular line every time.
parts:
I've been using data from camera traps to model occupancy against several covariates. I am currently using the unmarked package to create occupancy models with an unmarked frame however R aborts on running the code each time. 
This is the line causing issues when run R aborts 'due to a fatal error' and forces a new session.

m1 <- occu(formula = ~1 # detection formula first
           ~1, # occupancy formula second
           data = umf)

Any help would be appreciated
